free.text: Free Hobby: 1M req, 150 GB, 6 CPU h, 1k build min; no card

work.math: US$10 a month for the Pro base. 1M requests, 100 GB and 100 build minutes fit the listed allowances. Hobby commercial terms are unverified. CPU over 6 hours, provisioned memory, stored packages and tax are unknown.

US$10 + 21.78 excess CPU hours × US$0.10 = US$12.18 known subtotal. 1 million requests, 100 GB and 100 build minutes fit the allowances. Provisioned memory, package storage period, tax and workload fit are not confirmed.

DB storage comes to US$99 only if 10 GB means 10,000 MB and the extra 9,900 MB is charged. The billing period is not published. Database RAM, seven-day backups, internal 10 GB traffic, app cost and tax are not confirmed.
